claim: No identifier of any shape reaches the blinded copy, checked against the shipped file rather than against the mask list.
status_note: The corresponding email was written twice, once in fields.json and once as a literal in TOKEN_MASKS. Changing the field alone would have shipped a blinded copy carrying the new address in clear, because the mask still named the old one. The defect is not in a value, it is in keying a guard to a copy of the thing it guards.
value: The identity masks derive from the field store. The check reads the shipped blinded copy for email-shaped and ORCID-shaped strings and for the field values verbatim: 0 found, with dicom@dicomstandard.org the one allowed address.
floor: not applicable, this row counts identifiers that leaked
dropped: the ORCID is still a literal in the mask list because there is no ORCID field for it to derive from. The shape check covers it regardless, which is why the shape check exists
